Apple's 256GB MacBook Neo in citrus is $100 off at Amazon, bringing it back to the price the laptop started at before the memory crisis drove prices up across the company's lineup.

Check out all the MacBook Neo deals on Amazon

The affordable laptop made a splash earlier this year, putting a fire under the entire PC industry and proving to be one of the best laptops if you're on a budget.

MacBook Neo (256GB, Citrus): was $699 now $599
Apple's base MacBook Pro in the citrus colorway, with an A18 Pro chip, 8GB of RAM, 256GB of storage, and no Touch ID option. View Deal

The other colors — blush, indigo, and silver — are all $649 as of this writing for the 256GB configuration, or $50 off. All of the 512GB options that add a Touch ID fingerprint reader are $749 (also $50 off).

The A18 Pro in the MacBook Neo proved to be a decent performer for a basic laptop in our testing, excelling in single-core performance where it's needed most. The Mac can fall under memory pressure with 8GB of RAM, though macOS is pretty good at managing multitasking.
